title: Bonus Episode: Using Virtual Reality to Train Law Enforcement Officers with Gregory Kratzig, PhD

sentences.en: Hi, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: It's Caitlin Luna, host of Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是凯特琳·卢娜（Caitlin Luna），《心理学谈话》（Speaking of Psychology）的主持人。

sentences.en: This episode was recorded during
sentences.zh: 本期节目是在

sentences.en: APA's Technology, Mind, and Society conference held in October 2019 in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 2019年10月于华盛顿特区举办的美国心理学会（APA）“技术、思维与社会”会议期间录制的。

sentences.en: I was on maternity leave during that time, so my colleague Kim Mills was a guest hoSt.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在休产假，所以由我的同事金·米尔斯（Kim Mills）担任客座主持。

sentences.en: We hope you enjoy this episode.
sentences.zh: 希望大家喜欢这期节目。

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a biweekly podcast from the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《心理学谈话》，这是美国心理学会推出的一档双周播客，

sentences.en: Association that explores the role of psychology in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 旨在探讨心理学在日常生活中的作用。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: My guest today is Dr. Gregory Kratzig, an adjunct professor of psychology at the University
sentences.zh: 今天的嘉宾是格雷戈里·克拉齐格（Gregory Kratzig）博士，他是加拿大萨斯喀彻温省里贾纳大学的心理学兼职教授，

sentences.en: of Regina in Saskatchewan, Canada, and a global expert in simulation-based training, particularly in the world of law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 也是全球模拟训练领域的专家，尤其是在执法领域。

sentences.en: He has used virtual reality to train first responders to drive emergency vehicles and to help police officers make the best decisions when they're
sentences.zh: 他利用虚拟现实技术培训急救人员驾驶应急车辆，并帮助警官在面临

sentences.en: faced with choosing whether to use force.
sentences.zh: 是否使用武力的抉择时做出最佳决策。

sentences.en: I don't think it's a stretch to say that virtual reality is revolutionizing how we train people in law enforcement, as well as in other fields such as aviation and medicine.
sentences.zh: 我认为说虚拟现实正在彻底改变我们对执法人员以及航空和医学等其他领域的培训方式，一点也不夸张。

sentences.en: So thank you for joining us today, Dr. Kratzig.
sentences.zh: 那么，感谢您今天加入我们的节目，克拉齐格博士。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: So let's start by having you tell our listeners a little about the research you've conducted, specifically training law enforcement officers.
sentences.zh: 那么，首先请您向我们的听众介绍一下您所进行的研究，特别是针对执法人员的培训。

sentences.en: How are you using simulations?
sentences.zh: 您是如何使用模拟技术的？

sentences.en: Why are they well-suited to training police?
sentences.zh: 为什么它们非常适合警察培训？

sentences.en: We've been using simulation technology in the use-of-force area, so the video-based technology.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在武力使用领域使用模拟技术，也就是基于视频的技术。

sentences.en: Law enforcement's been using that for, you know, about three decades now, and it's evolved over time.
sentences.zh: 执法部门使用这种技术已经有大约三十年了，而且它一直在不断演进。

sentences.en: It's getting much better.
sentences.zh: 它正变得越来越好。

sentences.en: But more recently, we're now using simulation for firearms training and driving simulation.
sentences.zh: 但最近，我们开始将模拟技术用于枪械训练和驾驶模拟。

sentences.en: And what that provides us is an opportunity to train both police recruits as well as existing police officers in an environment that's safe.
sentences.zh: 它为我们提供了一个在安全环境中培训新警员和在职警官的机会。

sentences.en: So what I mean by that is we can't teach emergency response driving.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们无法在现实中教授紧急响应驾驶。

sentences.en: So clearing intersections, driving, you know, lights and sirens through the city streets in our city or any other city.
sentences.zh: 比如在城市街道上清理路口、开着警灯和警笛行驶。

sentences.en: But we can do that using simulation.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以通过模拟来实现。

sentences.en: So we can introduce opposing traffic, pedestrians, animals, anything that we want to.
sentences.zh: 我们可以引入对向交通、行人、动物，任何我们想要的元素。

sentences.en: And when something happens, you know, that's a teaching moment.
sentences.zh: 当发生情况时，那就是一个教学时刻。

sentences.en: We can talk to the recruit, what they did right, what they did wrong, why certain things happen to cause the collision.
sentences.zh: 我们可以与学员讨论他们做对了什么，做错了什么，以及为什么会发生导致碰撞的特定情况。

sentences.en: And then we hit the reset and we allow them to do it again.
sentences.zh: 然后我们按下重置键，让他们再做一次。

sentences.en: Something that you absolutely can't do in the real world.
sentences.zh: 这是你在现实世界中绝对做不到的事情。

sentences.en: Firearms is another area.
sentences.zh: 枪械是另一个领域。

sentences.en: It also allows us to train our recruits in a very safe environment.
sentences.zh: 它也让我们能在非常安全的环境中培训学员。

sentences.en: So they don't have to, you know, the, when you hold a live weapon, there's a certain anxiety that comes along with it.
sentences.zh: 他们不必……你知道，当你手持真枪时，会伴随一定的焦虑感。

sentences.en: And it kind of takes away from building of the skill itself of learning how to shoot a gun.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上会影响学习射击这项技能本身。

sentences.en: So we can remove that, focus on the actual skill acquisition, and then introduce the live fire later on.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以消除这种焦虑，专注于实际的技能习得，然后再引入实弹射击。

sentences.en: And that anxiety seems to really dissipate.
sentences.zh: 而且那种焦虑感似乎真的消散了。

sentences.en: But I understand that there's some resistance to this marksmanship training.
sentences.zh: 但我了解到，对于这种射击训练存在一些抵触情绪。

sentences.en: Is that coming from gun manufacturers?
sentences.zh: 这是来自枪支制造商吗？

sentences.en: Is it coming from police departments?
sentences.zh: 还是来自警察部门？

sentences.en: What's behind that?
sentences.zh: 这背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: It's definitely coming from the end user for sure.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是来自终端用户，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: You know, there's this long held belief that a bullet needs to come out of a gun and needs to recoil.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们长期以来一直认为子弹必须从枪里射出，必须有后坐力。

sentences.en: You need to smell the cordite in order to learn how to shoot.
sentences.zh: 你必须闻到火药味才能学会射击。

sentences.en: But if you learn all of the skills, the way you need to learn them, if you do that correctly, the bullet's going to go where you want it to go all the time anyways.
sentences.zh: 但如果你以正确的方式学习所有技能，只要方法得当，子弹总是会射向你想让它去的地方。

sentences.en: Everything happens after, everything happens before the bullet comes out of the gun itself.
sentences.zh: 一切都发生在子弹射出枪膛之前。

sentences.en: So the resistance is coming from those in the field that really are resistant of changing something that really hasn't changed
sentences.zh: 所以这种抵触情绪来自现场那些真正抗拒改变的人，因为过去100年来，

sentences.en: how we teach firearms training for the past 100 years.
sentences.zh: 我们教授枪械训练的方式确实没有变过。

sentences.en: And do people become more adept at marksmanship by going through it virtually first?
sentences.zh: 那么，人们通过先进行虚拟训练，在射击技术上会变得更熟练吗？

sentences.en: I mean, can you demonstrate that there's a, you know, a good reason for doing this in addition to what you've just described?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了您刚才描述的之外，您能证明这样做有充分的理由吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: We have, we've conducted a number of studies with the RCMP.
sentences.zh: 我们已经与加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）进行了一系列研究。

sentences.en: It has been replicated down here in the United States and with another agency in Canada.
sentences.zh: 这项研究在美国和加拿大的另一个机构也得到了复现。

sentences.en: And we have removed all of the live fire practice from our training program for this research only,
sentences.zh: 为了这项研究，我们从培训项目中移除了所有的实弹射击练习，

sentences.en: and demonstrated that the skills are acquired, that the skills transfer from the simulator to the live fire environment.
sentences.zh: 并证明了技能是可以习得的，技能可以从模拟环境转移到实弹射击环境。

sentences.en: And we have evidence that actually shows that the retention of the skill is nominally better than if they were trained in a fully traditional live fire setting.
sentences.zh: 我们有证据表明，技能的保持力实际上比在完全传统的实弹环境中训练要好。

sentences.en: So one of the factors that you also study is physiological arousal and how it affects decision making in law enforcement situations.
sentences.zh: 您研究的因素之一是生理唤醒，以及它如何影响执法情境下的决策。

sentences.en: And I think it's pretty well understood that policing can be a very hazardous line of work, which means that police officers may experience hypervigilance and other
sentences.zh: 我认为大家都很清楚，警察工作可能是一份非常危险的职业，这意味着警官可能会经历过度警觉和其他

sentences.en: forms of physiological arousal.
sentences.zh: 形式的生理唤醒。

sentences.en: When, when is this a good thing?
sentences.zh: 什么时候这是件好事？

sentences.en: And when is this bad for an officer in the field?
sentences.zh: 什么时候这对现场的警官来说是坏事？

sentences.en: Oh, that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 哦，这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And it's, and it's, it's quite complicated.
sentences.zh: 而且，这相当复杂。

sentences.en: So
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: what, what we've done, I mean, over the last, you know, I'm just going to say the last 10 years,
sentences.zh: 我们所做的，我是说，在过去，你知道，我就说过去10年吧，

sentences.en: we've developed different scenarios, both in the simulator and live in our police defensive tactics
sentences.zh: 我们开发了不同的场景，无论是在模拟器中还是在我们的警察防御战术实战中，

sentences.en: that try and replicate what could actually happen in the real world.
sentences.zh: 试图复制现实世界中可能发生的情况。

sentences.en: And so trying to stop a threat of some sort, you know, whether you're going to arrest them or, or if it's an active shooter situation.
sentences.zh: 比如试图阻止某种威胁，无论是逮捕他们，还是应对活跃枪手的情况。

sentences.en: So we build these scenarios and we believe that they're complicated for that particular recruit at a point in time and training, but we don't, and we also then believe that
sentences.zh: 所以我们构建了这些场景，我们认为对于特定阶段的学员来说，这些场景很复杂，但我们并不……而且我们还认为

sentences.en: they are eliciting, you know, emotional responses and cognitive demand on our recruits, but we really don't have the evidence to suggest that that's actually the case.
sentences.zh: 它们正在引发学员的情绪反应和认知需求，但我们确实没有证据表明情况确实如此。

sentences.en: So one of the reasons why we want to use the physiological equipment is to actually look at that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想要使用生理监测设备的原因之一，就是为了真正观察这一点。

sentences.en: Are we getting the type of output that we believe that we are when we designed a snare that we're supposed to get?
sentences.zh: 我们是否得到了我们在设计场景时预期的那种效果？

sentences.en: So that's one.
sentences.zh: 这是第一点。

sentences.en: The second thing that we want to make sure that we're doing is that if there is a
sentences.zh: 第二点，我们要确保的是，如果存在

sentences.en: high level of emotional arousal, and if we can demonstrate, you know, with the equipment that there is
sentences.zh: 高水平的情绪唤醒，并且如果我们能用设备证明存在

sentences.en: a large cognitive demand, that we can then incorporate additional tools in the training program for them to be able to work through that emotional arousal and to be able to resolve
sentences.zh: 巨大的认知需求，那么我们就可以在培训项目中加入额外的工具，让他们能够克服这种情绪唤醒，并能够以更好的方式，我想说，以更快、更安全的方式，为警官和他们面对的嫌疑人解决

sentences.en: whatever's in front of them in a better way, I guess, in a quicker, safer way for both the police officer and the suspect that they're dealing with.
sentences.zh: 眼前的问题。

sentences.en: So those are a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 所以这是几点考虑。

sentences.en: We also know that when you are talking about PTSD or other occupational stress injuries, that it's not just one traumatic event that necessarily causes that.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，当谈到创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）或其他职业压力损伤时，并不一定是由单一的创伤事件引起的。

sentences.en: It could be this notion of a thousand or several hundred different traumatic events that are smaller in nature, but it's just all of a sudden it's that
sentences.zh: 这可能是由成千上万或几百个性质较小的不同创伤事件累积而成的，但突然之间，就是那

sentences.en: one that actually becomes that trigger.
sentences.zh: 一个事件成为了触发点。

sentences.en: So the other thing that we want to do is to try and provide them with the tools to manage those stresses as they go through their career in an effort to try
sentences.zh: 所以我们想做的另一件事是，尝试为他们提供工具，在他们的职业生涯中管理这些压力，以努力

sentences.en: and mitigate the effects of PTSD.
sentences.zh: 减轻PTSD的影响。

sentences.en: So what are some of those tools?
sentences.zh: 那么这些工具是什么呢？

sentences.en: Is it cognitive behavioral therapy?
sentences.zh: 是认知行为疗法吗？

sentences.en: Is it, you know, what are you giving to police officers?
sentences.zh: 是……您给警官提供了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, we are trying some mindfulness training with some cadets.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们正在对一些学员进行正念训练。

sentences.en: We're doing a research project with them right now.
sentences.zh: 我们目前正在与他们进行一个研究项目。

sentences.en: We are also looking at doing augmented training with a number of cadets starting next year.
sentences.zh: 我们还计划从明年开始对一些学员进行增强训练。

sentences.en: And it's a program that was developed out of Harvard and Boston University.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由哈佛大学和波士顿大学开发的项目。

sentences.en: So we're looking at incorporating that into our program.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正考虑将其纳入我们的计划中。

sentences.en: And so think about cognitive behavioral therapy.
sentences.zh: 所以想想认知行为疗法。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: But instead of giving CBT and these tools to a person after they're injured, let's give it to them before they're
sentences.zh: 但与其在人受伤后才提供CBT和这些工具，不如在他们受伤前就提供，

sentences.en: injured, to be some sort of a preventative mitigating instrument to manage those stresses.
sentences.zh: 作为一种预防性的缓解手段来管理这些压力。

sentences.en: So body cameras and dashboard cameras have been very much in the news lately.
sentences.zh: 最近，随身摄像头和行车记录仪在新闻中出现得非常多。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering, are these included in your training?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，这些是否包含在您的培训中？

sentences.en: And if so, how?
sentences.zh: 如果是，是如何包含的？

sentences.en: No, they're not.
sentences.zh: 不，没有。

sentences.en: We do not have not used body worn cameras at all in my agency.
sentences.zh: 我的机构根本没有使用过随身摄像头。

sentences.en: And we're 25,000 police officers.
sentences.zh: 我们有25,000名警官。

sentences.en: And to date, we've made a decision not to use them.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，我们决定不使用它们。

sentences.en: We're still examining it.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在研究中。

sentences.en: But as of right now, we don't use body worn cameras.
sentences.zh: 但目前为止，我们不使用随身摄像头。

sentences.en: So I haven't worked with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有处理过这方面的工作。

sentences.en: Is that less prevalent in Canada than it is in the US?
sentences.zh: 这在加拿大是否比在美国更不普遍？

sentences.en: Do you think?
sentences.zh: 您觉得呢？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty, pretty becoming very widely used here in this country.
sentences.zh: 是的，在这个国家，它正变得非常广泛地使用。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's still lots of agencies that don't, that don't use it.
sentences.zh: 是的，仍然有很多机构不使用它。

sentences.en: What's the reason?
sentences.zh: 原因是什么？

sentences.en: Do you know?
sentences.zh: 您知道吗？

sentences.en: I think there's a number of, I think privacy is one, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多原因，隐私肯定是一个。

sentences.en: Costs is another one.
sentences.zh: 成本是另一个。

sentences.en: Storage of the videos is tremendously expensive and cataloging.
sentences.zh: 视频的存储和编目非常昂贵。

sentences.en: So there's a number of different factors that have to be considered.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多不同的因素需要考虑。

sentences.en: So can you give a description of how you use simulators to train police and first responders how to drive?
sentences.zh: 那么您能描述一下如何使用模拟器来培训警察和急救人员驾驶吗？

sentences.en: What's different about driving when you're a cop?
sentences.zh: 警察驾驶有什么不同之处？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: So we take the skills, assuming that a recruit is coming into the academy with some sort of civilian driving skills.
sentences.zh: 我们假设学员进入学院时已经具备某种平民驾驶技能，我们以此为基础进行培训。

sentences.en: And we take those skills and then build upon that.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这些技能，然后在此基础上进行提升。

sentences.en: So we introduce a police driving.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了警察驾驶技术。

sentences.en: So what that basically is, is giving them the tools in which to do this environmental scan.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是给他们提供进行环境扫描的工具。

sentences.en: So they're always supposed to be scanning the environment, looking for things that are out of place.
sentences.zh: 他们应该始终扫描环境，寻找不寻常的事物。

sentences.en: So they don't have to be in a pursuit drive.
sentences.zh: 他们不必非要在追捕中。

sentences.en: They don't have to be going to emergency call.
sentences.zh: 他们不必非要在赶往紧急呼叫的路上。

sentences.en: They just need to be aware of their environment, scanning back and forth and backing forth, looking for those things that are out of place.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要意识到周围的环境，来回扫描，寻找那些不寻常的事物。

sentences.en: And so those are what we're trying to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们试图做的事情。

sentences.en: As a civilian driver, we don't do that.
sentences.zh: 作为平民司机，我们不会那样做。

sentences.en: We're just focusing on what's in front of us, more or less, going from point A to point B.
sentences.zh: 我们或多或少只关注前方，从A点到B点。

sentences.en: And it's a very unconscious drive.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常无意识的驾驶。

sentences.en: Think about when you go to the grocery store, you don't really remember the journey to get there.
sentences.zh: 想想你去杂货店的时候，你其实并不记得去那里的过程。

sentences.en: You just remember getting there.
sentences.zh: 你只记得到达了那里。

sentences.en: For a police officer, they are needing to look at the entire environment, always looking for those things, someone who may need help or anything that's out of place.
sentences.zh: 对于警官来说，他们需要观察整个环境，始终寻找那些东西，比如可能需要帮助的人，或者任何不寻常的情况。

sentences.en: And that's, those are the kind of skills that we're, we're trying to give them.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们试图传授给他们的技能。

sentences.en: But while they're doing that, we also need to make sure that they're also have the proper vehicle position.
sentences.zh: 但在他们这样做的时候，我们还需要确保他们保持正确的车辆位置。

sentences.en: So as they're driving, they don't want to get boxed in behind a car just in case they need to go respond to emergency.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在驾驶时，不想被困在车流中，以防需要去响应紧急情况。

sentences.en: So vehicle positioning, being aware of where the traffic is and always allowing themselves a way out of a situation so they can get to the respondent's call.
sentences.zh: 所以车辆定位、意识到交通状况，并始终为自己留出一条出路，这样他们才能赶去响应呼叫。

sentences.en: So that's kind of, in a nutshell, what we're trying to teach the cadets.
sentences.zh: 所以，简而言之，这就是我们试图教给学员的内容。

sentences.en: It's a lot to be thinking about all at once.
sentences.zh: 要同时考虑这么多事情，确实很不容易。

sentences.en: It's a kind of multitasking.
sentences.zh: 这是一种多任务处理。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And then you throw a dispatcher on there, you know, so they throw in a license plate that, you know, can you do a check on this?
sentences.zh: 然后你还要加上调度员，你知道，他们会报出一个车牌号，问你能不能查一下？

sentences.en: And while they're still scanning back and forth, trying to understand where their vehicle is in the traffic, and then they got their computer on their
sentences.zh: 当他们还在来回扫描，试图了解车辆在车流中的位置时，他们还得看电脑，

sentences.en: officer for sure.
sentences.zh: 这对警官来说确实如此。

sentences.en: So we're trying to introduce those skills slowly in a simulator, do the confirmation in the live environment, come back, introduce another skill.
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图在模拟器中慢慢引入这些技能，在现实环境中进行确认，回来后再引入另一种技能。

sentences.en: And so we kind of go back and forth, kind of think of scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来回往复，可以把它想象成脚手架。

sentences.en: So we're just kind of building and building on those skills.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在这些技能的基础上不断构建。

sentences.en: And even though we haven't researched this anecdotally from our instructors, they're telling
sentences.zh: 尽管我们还没有对此进行研究，但根据我们的教官反馈，他们说

sentences.en: us that those cadets are coming into their respective parts of the program, much better equipped after they come into the simulator.
sentences.zh: 这些学员在进入模拟器后，能更好地掌握各自的课程内容。

sentences.en: So it's allowing us to introduce a certain set of skills.
sentences.zh: 所以这让我们能够引入一套特定的技能。

sentences.en: That's a lot to be thinking about, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这确实有很多值得思考的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, it's almost like you're having to learn how to effectively text and drive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直就像是你必须学会如何一边开车一边发短信。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like it's very dangerous, really.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听起来这真的很危险。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, there's lots of discussion about distracted driving, and yet we're telling our police officers, you need to do distracted driving.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于分心驾驶的讨论有很多，但我们却在告诉警察，你们需要进行分心驾驶。

sentences.en: But there's also a method to that.
sentences.zh: 但这也是有方法的。

sentences.en: So when they're on the radio, there's certain points on the drive, especially when they're driving lights and sirens somewhere, when you don't use your radio.
sentences.zh: 当他们在用无线电时，驾驶过程中有一些特定的节点，尤其是在鸣笛闪灯赶往某处时，是不应该使用无线电的。

sentences.en: So don't use it when you're just going into an intersection.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你刚要进入十字路口时，不要使用它。

sentences.en: If a dispatcher calls you, they don't know exactly where you are.
sentences.zh: 如果调度员呼叫你，他们并不知道你确切的位置。

sentences.en: Go on the radio as soon as you exit that intersection and go into the main way, because then that's safer.
sentences.zh: 等驶出路口进入主路后再使用无线电，因为那样更安全。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on in that intersection.
sentences.zh: 十字路口的情况非常复杂。

sentences.en: And when you're going through red light, all the civilian traffic, they have the right-of-way going green.
sentences.zh: 当你闯红灯时，所有平民车辆在绿灯时都有优先通行权。

sentences.en: So if there's a collision, the police officer is the one that created that collision, not the civilian population.
sentences.zh: 所以如果发生碰撞，是警察造成了碰撞，而不是平民。

sentences.en: So they have to then deal with that situation.
sentences.zh: 因此他们必须处理那种情况。

sentences.en: So the dispatcher, just give them two or three seconds, then get back on the radio and then respond to the dispatcher.
sentences.zh: 所以调度员那边，给他们两三秒钟，然后再用无线电回复调度员。

sentences.en: So we also teach them that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也教他们这一点。

sentences.en: Yes, there's lots of things going on, but take a break, get through safely, and then go on the radio.
sentences.zh: 是的，虽然有很多事情要处理，但请稍作停顿，安全通过后再使用无线电。

sentences.en: Any other findings in your work that you want to discuss or that you've been talking about here at the APA conference?
sentences.zh: 在你的工作中，还有什么其他发现是你想要讨论的，或者是在这次美国心理学会（APA）会议上谈论过的吗？

sentences.en: We've also been doing quite a bit of work with virtual reality.
sentences.zh: 我们也在虚拟现实方面做了不少工作。

sentences.en: We really believe that virtual reality is definitely the wave of the future for police training.
sentences.zh: 我们坚信虚拟现实绝对是未来警察培训的趋势。

sentences.en: We're part of a larger working group, international group, UK, US, and Australia, and us working on virtual reality as a training tool.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个大型国际工作组的成员，包括英国、美国和澳大利亚，我们都在致力于将虚拟现实作为一种培训工具。

sentences.en: We all have a little bit of expertise.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有一些专长。

sentences.en: Nobody has everything.
sentences.zh: 没有人拥有全部。

sentences.en: And then we've partnered with academia to help us out, build virtual reality scenarios, mostly right now for beta testing.
sentences.zh: 我们还与学术界合作，帮助我们构建虚拟现实场景，目前主要是为了进行测试。

sentences.en: We're hoping to get them into the program by the end of the year, so that we could do some actual empirical studies on virtual reality.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在年底前将它们纳入项目，以便对虚拟现实进行一些实际的实证研究。

sentences.en: But when you think about simulation, these driving simulators are massive pieces of technology.
sentences.zh: 但当你想到模拟时，这些驾驶模拟器是庞大的技术设备。

sentences.en: They're very expensive.
sentences.zh: 它们非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And you should be able to do the same thing in a virtual world for a fraction of the cost, but it's much, much more immersive.
sentences.zh: 你应该能够以极低的成本在虚拟世界中做同样的事情，而且它更具沉浸感。

sentences.en: And that's where we want to end up, is creating something as realistic as we can, what they might experience in the real world.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们想要达到的目标，即创造出尽可能逼真的场景，模拟他们在现实世界中可能遇到的情况。

sentences.en: So that's where we're putting a lot of energy into virtual reality right now.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们目前投入大量精力在虚拟现实上的原因。

sentences.en: So what are some of the other scenarios?
sentences.zh: 那么还有哪些其他场景呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not always a shoot, don't shoot situation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，并不总是“开枪或不开枪”的情况。

sentences.en: It could be, I don't know, you're making a call for domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 可能是，我不知道，比如你接到一个家庭暴力的报警。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: We're doing domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做家庭暴力的场景。

sentences.en: We've replicated our drug house in virtual reality,
sentences.zh: 我们在虚拟现实中复制了我们的毒品窝点，

sentences.en: a mental health scenario where a person who is in crisis and we're interacting with that individual to calm them down and get them the help that they need.
sentences.zh: 还有一个心理健康场景，其中一个人处于危机中，我们与该个人互动以安抚他们，并为他们提供所需的帮助。

sentences.en: So it's not just shoot, don't shoot.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅仅是开枪或不开枪。

sentences.en: Very few of our scenarios are that.
sentences.zh: 我们的场景中很少是那样的。

sentences.en: Most of ours are de-escalation.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数场景都是关于降级冲突的。

sentences.en: Virtually almost, virtually all of our calls for service are not violent in nature.
sentences.zh: 实际上，几乎我们所有的服务呼叫都不是暴力性质的。

sentences.en: They're really easily de-escalated and they usually resolve without instance.
sentences.zh: 它们很容易降级，通常都能和平解决。

sentences.en: And that's what we're really focusing on, the de-escalation part, especially with the mental health.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们真正关注的，即降级冲突的部分，特别是在心理健康方面。

sentences.en: That's one area that we're putting more time in.
sentences.zh: 这是我们投入更多时间的一个领域。

sentences.en: And I think virtual reality is going to really help us with that.
sentences.zh: 我认为虚拟现实真的会在这方面帮助我们。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a place where psychology can really, really play a role.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是心理学确实可以发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: Do you think that it's getting better?
sentences.zh: 你认为情况正在好转吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I know that it's been problematic for years with police not being able to effectively
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我知道多年来警察一直无法有效地

sentences.en: determine whether a person in crisis is going to be violent or there's a way to talk to a person who's got some kind of a mental issue or mental illness.
sentences.zh: 判断处于危机中的人是否会变得暴力，或者是否有办法与患有某种心理问题或精神疾病的人沟通。

sentences.en: Well, I think that's a larger social issue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是一个更大的社会问题。

sentences.en: I think we've put a lot on police officers.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们给警察施加了太大的压力。

sentences.en: I mean, they're a first responder, but they're responding not only to crimes, but they're responding to all of these mental health.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们是第一响应者，但他们不仅要应对犯罪，还要应对所有这些心理健康问题。

sentences.en: And we're expecting them to be able to diagnose somebody almost as soon as they get on the scene.
sentences.zh: 我们期望他们一到现场就能诊断出某人。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, you must have schizophrenia or you have bipolar disorder.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，你一定患有精神分裂症或者你有双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: Well, they're not trained for that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们没有受过那方面的训练。

sentences.en: And so we need to help give them some tools to be able to identify someone who might be in mental health crisis or
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要帮助他们提供一些工具，以便能够识别可能处于心理健康危机中的人，或者

sentences.en: substance abuse or whatever it might be so that they can get that person to help.
sentences.zh: 药物滥用或其他任何情况，这样他们才能让那个人得到帮助。

sentences.en: But we're just asking our police to do more and more and more and more.
sentences.zh: 但我们只是要求我们的警察做的事情越来越多。

sentences.en: And they're really not equipped.
sentences.zh: 而他们实际上并没有配备相应的装备。

sentences.en: I think they do a fine job.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们做得很好。

sentences.en: They do a great job with the tools they have, but we need to find a way to give them more tools, better tools to be able to do their job.
sentences.zh: 他们用现有的工具做得很好，但我们需要找到一种方法给他们更多的工具，更好的工具来完成他们的工作。

sentences.en: Is what you're doing then being shared with the book training academies?
sentences.zh: 那么你们所做的工作是否正在与培训学院分享？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Everything that I belong to a couple of different groups, international groups, and all of our information is disseminated during some of those
sentences.zh: 我所属的几个不同的国际小组，我们所有的信息都会在其中一些会议上进行传播，

sentences.en: meetings, as well as the senior leadership within our organization.
sentences.zh: 以及我们组织内部的高层领导。

sentences.en: They meet with senior leaders throughout the world on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 他们定期与世界各地的高层领导会面。

sentences.en: And that information is also shared at the very, very top level.
sentences.zh: 这些信息也会在最高层进行分享。

sentences.en: So there's lots of opportunities to disseminate this information and we do as soon as it becomes available.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多机会传播这些信息，我们一旦获得就会立即分享。

sentences.en: We absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对会。

sentences.en: And then we also take in information from our partners as well on the work that they're doing and see if we can apply to our own agency.
sentences.zh: 我们也会从合作伙伴那里获取他们正在做的工作的信息，看看是否能应用到我们自己的机构中。

sentences.en: This is all really interesting and very important work.
sentences.zh: 这一切都非常有趣，也非常重要。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: And thanks for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你今天加入我们。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: And thank you very much for your intereSt. So I just want to remind our listeners that we at Speaking of Psychology want to hear from you.
sentences.zh: 也非常感谢你的关注。我想提醒我们的听众，我们《心理学谈话》节目非常希望能听到你们的声音。

sentences.en: You can email your comments and ideas for future episodes to speakingofpsychologyatapa.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以将你的评论和对未来节目的想法发送电子邮件至 speakingofpsychology@apa.org。

sentences.en: And please give us a rating in iTunes.
sentences.zh: 请在 iTunes 上给我们评分。

sentences.en: It's really helpful.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Speaking of Psychology is part of the APA podcast network, which includes other informative podcasts, such as APA Journals Dialogue about new psychological research and progress
sentences.zh: 《心理学谈话》是美国心理学会播客网络的一部分，该网络还包括其他信息丰富的播客，例如《APA 期刊对话》关于新的心理学研究，以及

sentences.en: notes about the practice of psychology.
sentences.zh: 关于心理学实践的《进度笔记》。

sentences.en: You can find all our podcasts on Apple, Stitcher, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Apple、Stitcher 或任何你获取播客的地方找到我们所有的播客。

sentences.en: And you can also go to our website, www.speakingofpsychology.org and listen to more episodes.
sentences.zh: 你也可以访问我们的网站 www.speakingofpsychology.org 收听更多剧集。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills with the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 我是美国心理学会的 Kim Mills。
